table.name: TLGNC_CREDIT_NOTE
table.description: Credit Notes for any type: Bulk/Bag/Special Products. A credit note is related to the order_item to be credited. Most of the credit note data is taken from the original order, only additionally needed information is stored in credit_note. The ctl_cre_ts is the date/time when the credit note is created, which is not necessarily identical to when it was sent to SAP.

column.name: ORDER_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order_item. The order item which is credited by this credit note. The order ID is in order_item.order_id.

column.name: ORDER_NUMBER
column.description: The credit note number, used for external systems (output, SAP). This is generated by the same mechanism as order.order_number (based on sequence slgnc_order_number), but each credit note gets its own number.

column.name: CREDIT_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure on which the credit_quantity is based. This should never differ from order_item.return_uom_cd

column.name: CREDIT_QUANTITY
column.description: The credited quantity. This is equal to order_item.returned_quantity at the time the credit note is created. This value should never differ, but it is kept redundant in the case where an order_item needs to be corrected by creating a second credit note for the same item.

column.name: NOTE_DELIVERY
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note (PDF). The text for credit notes is generated by the system, e.g. 'Return qty. from delivery LOGON_ORDER_NUBER'.>

column.name: SENT_SALESDOC_TO_SAP_TS
column.description: Timestamp when the credit note's sales document was actually sent to SAP. See also tlgnc_order.sent_salesdoc_to_sap_ts.
